text.p: China Industrial Group Inc said it has temporarily delayed its Form 10k filing for the period ended May 31, in order to permit the completion of a year end audit by the company's auditors.
The company said the delay results primarily from various issues stemming from the sale of certain assets and the acquisition of its cashmere business.

Certain of the operative documents had to be translated from Chinese into English for auditors and attorneys, China Industrial said. The complexity of the transactions together with the translation requirements necessitated the delay.

China Industrial also said it expects to continue to perform successfully in the cashmere business. The cashmere business is characterized by profit margins which it anticipates will give rise to favorable net income and increasing shareholder value.
